items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Uh-huh' and 'Right, right' to the interviewer's statements about Bunky Green, without providing any personal anecdote or connection.

ctx.x: And as I say, these young trumpet players, they were fantastic. And I had a little alto player, and I'll have to find his name here. I'll get it for you in a minute, but he was fantastic. And he reminded me of Bunky Green. He played so good and he just loved it. And he was about Bunky's size and about his age, maybe a little younger.
Yeah. Well, Bunky's got several students.
